summary: Validated new Citadelle transaction endpoints (withdraw-offer & refuse-counter) across backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright). All required scenarios pass: buyer can withdraw in offer_sent/offer_countered/offer_accepted (→ cancelled + cancelled_by_buyer=true); seller gets 403; payment_done/completed → 400. refuse-counter succeeds only in offer_countered (→ offer_refused); 400 otherwise; 403 for seller. Frontend shows btn-accept-counter + btn-refuse-counter side-by-side (same y=160) on offer_countered, and btn-withdraw-offer + modal + withdraw-confirm-btn on offer_accepted; both confirm flows correctly transition backend state.

issues: React hydration warnings: <span> inside <select>/<option> (ve-dynamic wrappers). Pre-existing, unrelated to this PR — but worth cleaning up as it clutters console.

critical_code_review_comments: CitadelleTransactionDetail.js is 1040 lines — should be split (>700 line guideline).
refuse_counter_offer uses window.confirm() via handler; UX would be better with a proper modal like withdraw flow (consistency).

e2e flow tests (create offer via POST /transactions/offer) were skipped because seeded listings have status='sold' — consider seeding at least one 'published' listing owned by test.vendeur for full e2e coverage.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 targeted tests pass; 2 flow tests skipped due to listing state)
